title: OpenClaw Getting Started: Your First AI Agent in 30 Minutes
summary: From zero to a working OpenClaw AI agent in 30 minutes. Two paths: Blink Claw (managed, deploys in about a minute) and self-hosted. SOUL.md, HEARTBEAT.md, and your first task.
body_markdown: Yes. OpenClaw runs on any ARM Linux device with Node.js 22+. The Raspberry Pi 5 is the most common dedicated home agent setup. The install is identical to standard Linux. Use Tailscale Serve for secure remote access. If you want to avoid the hardware cost and maintenance, Blink Claw starts from about $45/month per agent plus model usage.
